summary: Batch A, family A16 (whole-graph clique number), on the fixed A15 pin 7612210 (no private union). The canonical is upstream GraphTheory.core.coloring.omega_mem (notation ω): ω([set: G]) = \max_(B in cliques [set x in [set: G]]) #|B|. X112's and X121's helpers already are ω([set: G]) and stay as conversions; X124's bigmax over all cliques equals it by the new base adapter omega_setT_maxE, proved without any nonempty guard. No clique-number primitive is added. The public client shows K_0 = 0, K_1 = 1, K_n = n, a nonempty edgeless graph = 1 and the order bound, as exact natural numbers.
